"RIDGE RACER" ver 1.04   (Apr. 2012)

NOTE
In order to connect to PlayStation®Network, you must update to the latest version.
Also, you cannot race against players using a different version.

UPDATE INFO

- Adjustments made to courses available as downloadable content on PlayStation®Store

Update details:
Adjustments made to the following courses:

  Redstone Thunder Road
  Silver Mountain Skyway

Failure to apply this update may result in glitches occurring during gameplay on the courses listed above.

- Various additional graphic tweaks

"RIDGE RACER" ver 1.03   (Feb. 2012)

UPDATE INFO

- Updated lobby search functionality

Update details:
Lobbies in Online Battle which the user cannot be matched with due to NAT issues, etc., have been removed from the lobby search results.

- Fixed Nitrous Absorb glitch

Update details:
Nitrous Absorb will not function against ghosts displayed in Time Attack.

- Stabilized frame rate

Update details:
Improved frame rate stability during races.

- Various additional graphic tweaks and bug fixes

"RIDGE RACER" ver 1.02   (Feb. 2012)

UPDATE INFO

- Updated screen before race begins in certain modes

Update details:
A starting grid will be displayed on the loading screen before a race begins in Online Battle and Face-to-Face Battle.

- Updated icons in the racing HUD

Update details:
The colors of icons on the course map have been updated to differentiate between rivals and allies. Depending on the active mission, rivals will be displayed in red, while allies will be displayed in blue. Racers who are neither rivals nor allies will be displayed in white.

- Added info for leading racers to racing HUD

Update details:
The online IDs and team icons of the 1st to 3rd place racers will be displayed during the race in Online Battle and Face-to-Face Battle.

- Added info regarding lobby status to racing HUD

Update details:
Text announcing the arrival/departure of racers to and from the lobby will be displayed during the race in Online Battle and Face-to-Face Battle.

- Added Friend icon to lobby display

Update details:
Friend icons will be displayed for racers who are registered as Friends on PlayStation®Network.

- Updated main menu

Update details:
A stamp will be displayed on the main menu to indicate VIP status in Credit Ranking or Score Ranking.

- Added profile ranking display

Update details:
Player profiles can be viewed in the various ranking displays. Touch a player's name on the list to display his/her profile.

- Updated Global Ghost icon

Update details:
An icon unique to Global Ghosts will be displayed in game.

- Updated replay/ghost data displays

Update details:
The course name and time info have been added to the replay/ghost data save and load displays.

- Added function to Media Player

Update details:
Sound effects can be created by touching the rear touch pad while holding the L button during replays.

- Updated the replay sub menu design

Update details:
The design of the sub menu displayed at the end of a race has been updated.

- Updated software manual

Update details:
Updated screenshots in software manual to reflect the updated replay sub menus. Load time for the software manual has also been improved.

- Added support for English text

Update details:
In-game text is displayed in English when the PlayStation®Vita system's language is set to any language other than Japanese. (The software manual is only available in Japanese)

- Updated user interface for joining a Planetary League team
- Improved stability for downloadable content
- Various additional graphic tweaks and bug fixes

"RIDGE RACER" ver 1.01   (Dec. 2011)

UPDATE INFO

- Improved stability for all online features
